part: ESP32-S3 Hardware Design Guidelines (Schematic Checklist, PCB Layout Design) - the SoC on U-MCU-RT; drives C-EN and R-TXD-SER
notes: GENUINE Espressif 'ESP Hardware Design Guidelines' for the ESP32-S3, 42 pp, built 2026-09-29 (PDF CreationDate) from the 'latest' (master) docs - a living document, so this copy is the one cited. Text layer extracts (pymupdf). What it gives: p.8 1.3.2 Power Supply, 'add an ESD protection diode and at least 10 uF capacitor at the main power entrance'; p.11 1.3.4 Chip Power-up and Reset Timing, 'it is advised to add an RC delay circuit at the CHIP_PU pin. The recommended setting for the RC delay circuit is usually R = 10 kOhm and C = 1 uF' and 'make the CHIP_PU trace as short as possible', with t_STBL and t_RST 50 us minimum (the same as ESP32-S3-datasheet-v2.2.pdf Table 2-13 p.30); p.16 1.3.7 UART, 'It is recommended to connect a 499 Ohm series resistor to the U0TXD line to suppress harmonics'; p.25 power traces, ESD diodes near the power input and a 10 uF before the trace enters the chip. Fetched for review issue #14 (A2, A3) and #11 F7, which cited the online checklist
